ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Archies Limited announced the resignation of Mr. Faizan Rashid Bhat as an Independent Director, effective August 5, 2026, citing personal reasons and other professional commitments. Both the company and Mr. Bhat explicitly confirmed there are no other material reasons for his departure, seeking to pre-empt potential speculation. While the stated reasons are common, the loss of an Independent Director can minimally impact board independence and oversight, with the repeated assurance of "no other material reasons" potentially seen as a minor yellow flag.
